OperatorTour.title: What you'll find on an operator page
OperatorTour.lead: Every operator page is built the same way. Go through it like three stops on a line.

buy.title: Step 1. How to buy and validate a ticket
buy.text: We show every way to buy: ticket machine, app, service point, card. Each comes with step-by-step instructions and whether the ticket needs validating.

prices.title: Step 2. How much a ticket costs
prices.text: All fares in one place: single, multi-day and monthly tickets. You see the standard and reduced price at a glance.

zones.title: Step 3. Which zones a ticket covers
zones.text: A zone diagram and a plain description of how far a ticket takes you.

finish.title: End of the line
finish.text: You know which ticket to buy, what it costs and how far it takes you. Now look up your city.

AiSources.title: Where this information comes from
AiSources.lead: Content is drafted by artificial intelligence (AI) from operators' official websites. A person checks it.

read.title: AI reads operator websites
read.text: It collects information from official regulations and fare tables.

check.title: A person checks the content
check.text: A moderator compares the page with the source. We give the source and the date it was checked.

report.title: You can report an error
report.text: Every page has a "Report an error" button. Always confirm prices and rules with the operator.
